title: readme-quickstart.sh runs the README's commands but never compares the example outputs shown below them
description: LCLI-583 found README.md's 'lore check --json' example showing a check.report shape that has never existed ({schemaVersion:"1", data:{ok,drift,brokenLinks,portability}}), in a README that ships in the npm tarball. LCLI-571's scripts/readme-quickstart.sh runs the commands between the quickstart markers verbatim, but not the '$ lore ... ' example transcripts after them, so an example can drift from real output with every gate green. LCLI-583 fixed the text by hand. This task makes the check mechanical: after the quickstart runs, run each marked example command in the same repository and compare its output (for JSON, parsed; for --plain, exact) with the README block, failing on a difference. Examples today: 'lore tasks stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders --plain' and 'lore check --json'. It touches scripts/, so it needs a reviewer pass.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each README example transcript in scope is compared with real output from the quickstart repository by a CI-run gate
The gate is proven red with a deliberately wrong README example and green on the correct one, as two measurements
